planner_plan.bridge_text: Even though these pages speak only in English, the magic of the hollow tree remains the same for us both. Lina stood before the bark, feeling the hum vibrate through her boots as she stepped into the shadows.

replacement_segments.text: On the edge of the little wool-grey village where Lina lived, there stood a hollow tree taller than the church. Every winter night, a low humming drifted out of its bark, and the grown-ups said: leave that tree alone. But the night her grandmother fell asleep without finishing their story, Lina put on her red wool coat and walked across the frosty field to listen. She reached out, pressing her palm against the ancient, humming wood, ready to see what secrets were hidden away from the village eyes.

results.label: spoiler-motivation-too-early
results.qa_question: Why is the old fox so grumpy?
results.qa_answer: Mosk has guarded the secrets of the hollow tree for so many long winters that he has forgotten how to be anything but stern. He fears that if he grows too kind, the magic hidden deep below might slip away into the cold night air.

planner_plan.bridge_text: The memory of those long winters keeps Mosk's heart tucked away like a hidden treasure, though Lina's arrival stirs the dust of his solitude. She stands firm on the step, waiting for him to decide if he will let her pass.

replacement_segments.text: Lina stood her ground, sensing that his sternness was really just a heavy coat of protection he wore against the world. She knew that behind those sharp eyes, he was still the keeper of the tree's deep, humming secrets, and she wasn't ready to turn back just yet.

Mosk pointed at the door, but Lina reached into her pocket and pulled out the last apple of the season. She set it on the step between them, offering it as a peace token for the trouble of her visit. Mosk stared at the fruit for a long time, his stern posture softening, before he stood up, tied his vest, and stepped onto the first stair without a word.

planner_plan.bridge_text: Even as the firefly’s light flickers low, Lina’s gentle presence brings a glimmer of hope to the mossy floor. With the heavy weight of the past finally shared, the two friends turn their attention back to the glowing queen.
